definitionZh: 网格柱 CSS 的短手属性通过贡献一条线,一个跨,或任何(自动)到其网格位置来指定网格项在网格列内的大小和位置,从而指定其网格区域的内启动和内端边缘.
sourceDefinition: The grid-column CSS shorthand property specifies a grid item's size and location within a grid column by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the inline-start and inline-end edge of its grid areas.
